questions.question: fork() created PCBs. What does the switch do with them?
options: Saves old registers/stack-ptr, loads new ones
questions.explanation: Pause = save; resume = restore; rsp swap picks the stack.

questions.question: Why push callee-saved regs (rbx, rbp, r12-r15)?
options: ABI promises they survive calls; switch must honor that
questions.explanation: Skipping one leaks old task state into the new task.

questions.question: movq %rsp,(%rdi) + movq %rsi,%rsp do what?
options: Stash old stack-ptr, load new stack-ptr (the switch itself)
questions.explanation: Two moves = which stack %rsp names is which task runs.

questions.question: get_rsp returns via?
questions.explanation: Integer returns ride %rax per System V.

questions.question: New task's stack needs what pre-seeded for ret to work?
options: A return address on top (where to land)
questions.explanation: ret pops the landing address; thread creation plants it (capstone).

questions.question: Your sim vs Linux preemption?
options: Sim is cooperative (you choose); Linux preempts via timer
